state.asserts: whether the rung's CODE exists on this coordinate, and whether a measured anchor plus a wired derivation can price its peak
state.binding: scripts/generate-memory-matrix.mjs#cellState — a pure function of (implementation, anchor present, derivation defined). No record, plan row, geometry, campaign or currency digest may enter it (sc-22513, epic 22505 E5)

conformanceStates.definition: Implemented, a measured anchor covers this (model, tier, backend lane), and the lane's analytic derivation is wired — so an unmeasured request geometry is priced from the anchor.
Implemented and anchored, but no derivation is wired for this lane, so the anchor bounds nothing beyond its own measured point.
The code path exists and is statically evidenced; no measured anchor covers it, so its peak is priced by the lane's analytic floor.
The rung cannot apply to this architecture; there is nothing to measure.
No implementation of this rung on this route.

summary.publicationPredicate: A coordinate is published when it carries a claim a per-lane census cannot: a measured memory anchor covers its (model, tier, backend lane), or it is structurally exempt. A bare `Implemented` or `Missing` state is a property of the whole lane, replicated across every tier x mode x overlay, and is counted in `summary.elidedByState` and the per-(entry, backend, rung) `coverage` census instead of restated thousands of times.

It is attested on a MEASURED witness instead: the E6 falsification fixture re-measured krea_2_turbo q4 at a5f643ae (22 first-parent merges after 3cd86ba2) on the same GPU and the cold staged control reproduces the packaged anchor per phase. The remaining a5f643ae..c6d6a4db range is accounting-only: gen-core lib.rs (re-export), memory_strategy.rs (contract types), weightsmeta.rs (walker hidden-cache skip) and candle-gen quant/sidecar.rs (CACHE_DIR constant re-homed, same value). Extended to 8a65db2a (sc-22723 feature pin, inference PRs #946-#958): c6d6a4db..8a65db2a touches four files of this closure and none is a load or device path - gen-core encoder_contract.rs (packed-marker struct kept whole, a stale-marker allowance only mlx-gen-flux2 calls, the hf_cache_discovery_roots authorization helper, tests), gen-core lib.rs (its re-export), gen-core wan_i2v_memory.rs (Wan-only identity tokens) and candle-gen-krea lib.rs (the per-(route, proven tier) identity table and weights-free surfaces; the q4 turbo identity this anchor is keyed to is unchanged, and the new provable-tier read consults the marker the loader already validated). loader.rs, pipeline.rs, transformer/, control*.rs, candle-gen quant/ and every device path are untouched. Extended to 563c44e1 (sc-22738, the epic final pin = inference main, merge of feature PR #960 over main 1cd0e393): 8a65db2a..563c44e1 changes nine inference files and exactly two are in this closure, gen-core encoder_contract.rs and lib.rs. Both are a REMOVAL, not a change of behaviour: inference PR #961 (sync of main into the feature branch) drops the sc-22727 stale-packed-marker tolerance that sc-22760 made unnecessary - the two entry points `source_for_load_with_stale_packed_marker` / `validate_source_for_discovery_with_stale_packed_marker`, the `RequiredWithStalePackedMarker` policy arm and its `stale_packed_marker()` reader, the `declared_quant` rewrite in `validate_source_with_policy` that was the identity for every other policy, `PackedQuantization` back to crate-private, and the allowance test; lib.rs drops the matching re-export. The only production caller of the removed surface was mlx-gen-flux2 (the FLUX.2 Klein turnkey inventory), which this closure does not reach; `source_for_load`, `validate_source_for_discovery`, `requires_config` for `Required` and every shard/header/quantization-evidence check this model executes are byte-for-byte the same code path before and after. The remaining seven files (mlx-gen-flux2 artifact_inventory.rs / loader.rs / memory_strategy.rs / model.rs, its two test files, release/real-weight-models.toml) are outside this closure. No load or device path this anchor reaches changed. Extended to 3b922bac (sc-22738, inference main = the merge of PR #962 over 563c44e1, its first parent): 563c44e1..3b922bac changes fourteen inference files, all under crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea and crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea-realtime (the harness-authorized calibration_fault hooks at every phase exit of the MLX krea base and realtime generators, their memory_strategy.rs helpers and tests), and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is EMPTY - this is the CANDLE krea closure (candle-gen-krea and candle-gen), which never links mlx-gen-krea or mlx-gen-krea-realtime. The closure digest is byte-identical across the range (config/anchor-loader-closures.json records the same digest for this model at 563c44e1 and 3b922bac; only krea_2_raw:mlx and krea_2_turbo:mlx moved), so this is the trivial extension the bump script's remediation names: nothing this anchor loads or executes changed, and no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement. Extended to e16c6a55 (sc-22738 fourth terminal pin, 2026-09-07; inference main = the merge of PR #965 fix/sc-22738-wan-rehost-tolerance over #964 fix/sc-22738-wan-t2v-memory-contract over #963 fix/sc-22738-mlx-progress-boundaries over 3b922bac): 3b922bac..e16c6a55 changes eleven inference files (gen-core residency.rs and wan_i2v_memory.rs; mlx-gen-bernini bernini.rs and its conformance test; mlx-gen-mage model.rs and pipeline.rs; mlx-gen-wan config.rs, i2v_memory_strategy.rs, memory_strategy.rs and model.rs; one mlx-gen-flux real-weight test) and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is exactly ONE file, crates/contracts/gen-core/src/residency.rs.
